name: feedbackmind-ai
description: FeedbackMind AI — User Feedback Synthesizer using Groq and Hindsight

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
